environment.storage: local NVMe for every input, output and scratch file

method: STAR Suite 1.9.4 processed each Perturb-seq dataset's gene-expression and feature libraries in one run and was compared with Cell Ranger 9.0.1 multi. For MSK 30-KO (ES sample: gene expression, 30 CRISPR guides and a 245,979-barcode LARRY lineage library) the reference time is the sum of the two Cell Ranger runs needed for the same outputs. The A375 gene-expression library is 10x 5' sequenced from read 2 only and is counted with --soloStrand Reverse; MSK is 3' and counted Forward. Runs were made one at a time on a quiet machine with the page cache dropped first; elapsed time is whole-process wall-clock time from /usr/bin/time. Cell Ranger 9.0.1 ran with BAM output and secondary analysis disabled at the same thread count and was timed to completion. CRISPR-call agreement is the fraction of shared cells whose called guide set is identical; feature UMI Pearson is on per-guide UMI sums over shared cells; per-cell Pearson is on per-barcode UMI totals. Gene-level concordance is the Spearman correlation (tied ranks averaged) and the Pearson correlation of raw per-gene count totals over the cells called by both tools, over every gene in both annotations, zero-count genes included.
limitations: Each timing is one completed run rather than a replicated distribution.
The superseded record reported an earlier 1.7.0 candidate, filtered gene Pearson and a UCSF dataset that is not part of this comparison; its values are not comparable.
The A375 gene Pearson is set mainly by one intronic locus (LINGO1) that the two tools count differently; an earlier A375 run counted the 5' library unstranded and is not used.
Cell Ranger outputs are the comparator, not a ground truth.
